thread:
oliver: Heads up — product asked for more RBAC telemetry in the Console: per-route denies, latency for permission checks, and top denied principals. Concern: don’t want PII/tenant IDs leaking into analytics. Thoughts?

dina: Agreed. Product wants to tie denies back to customers for support though — we need a privacy-safe way to do that.

cheng: We can hash tenant_id+salt in telemetry so dashboards can show "customer X" consistently without raw IDs. Caveat: salt management and whether hashing is permitted for enterprise legal contracts.

sarah: Proposal: two telemetry modes exposed in Console: `Metrics` (aggregated, no raw IDs) and `Audit` (full detail, only for enterprise tenants who opt in). Toggle must be admin-only and documented.

privacy-eng: Important: Audit logs are security/audit artifacts. If we store raw principals we need retention, access controls, and probably 2FA to view. Also consider data residency for EU tenants.

oliver: Also a cost angle — permission checks are high-cardinality events (every request). We should sample denies by default (e.g., 1%) and keep 100% for admins or on explicit incidents. Any objections?

cheng: Implementation note from runtime side: emit a small telemetry proto for permission events:
```
message PermTelemetry {
  string outcome = 1; // allow|deny|fallback
  string rule_id = 2;
  string route = 3;
  string principal_hash = 4; // sha256(tenant_id + ":" + principal_id + salt)
  int64 latency_ms = 5;
}
```
This keeps the payload tiny and avoids raw tenant ids. Retention and decryptability depend on salt handling.

product-liz: From product/dashboard POV they want a 'Top denied routes' card plus a way to click into an example denied request. Examples must be obfuscated (mask path params and principal). Showing a sample request body is useful for support.

sarah: UX idea: show masked examples by default, and add a "Reveal details (enterprise admins only)" button that records an access audit and requires confirmation.

ops-bot: deploy: runtime permission-telemetry v1 -> staging at 2026-03-22 09:00 UTC.

dina: We also need per-tenant retention controls via API and Console. Defaults: Metrics 30d, Audit 365d. Legal/security to sign off. Who owns the policy?

privacy-eng: I'll draft the retention and access policy. Also recommending per-tenant KMS-backed salt so hashes can't be correlated if a tenant requests deletion.

cheng: Dev tasks: prototype telemetry proto + runtime toggle for sampling and redaction; add flag to emit unhashed audit events only when `audit_opt_in` is true for tenant.

oliver: Action items: cheng prototype + PR; privacy-eng policy draft; product-liz dashboard mock; ops confirm staging rollout. Ping back here with links to PR/mock. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
